split: approximately 75/25 stratified group holdout by exact message text; seed=42; threshold tuned on 5-fold group out-of-fold training predictions
model: word+character TF-IDF with class-weighted logistic regression
threshold_objective: maximize F2 for spam on training-only group out-of-fold predictions
limitations: Random group holdout by exact message text from a non-chronological historical corpus. Threshold is a research choice, not a deployed policy. Public SMS can contain personal information; only aggregate metrics and message-free row-level scores are published.
